subject: Following up on the portable printer purchase
text: Hello, I hope you’re doing well, and I wanted to follow up politely about the portable printer I bought last month. The overall purchase experience was positive, and I really appreciate the careful packaging and the quick note you sent afterward. The device works well for printing small labels, and the app connects more reliably after the update. There is one small technical issue I’d like to mention, though: the power button feels a little stiff when pressed firmly, and a few of the ink cartridges make a faint clicking noise while starting up. It does not seem to affect print quality so far, but I wanted to ask whether this is normal for this model or whether there is a simple cleaning step I might have missed. If you have a moment, I would be grateful for any guidance or a link to troubleshooting notes, and if the parts are inexpensive I’d also be open to ordering replacements. Also, the instruction sheet arrived slightly creased, which made the reset sequence hard to read, but I managed to find the online copy. I understand these devices can have quirks, and I am not worried, just curious whether other users report the same button resistance. If it is only a matter of lubrication or firmware behavior, please let me know rather than sending the whole unit back. Thank you again for your help and for taking the time to make the sale so smooth. Best wishes,
